description: Type-safe i18n for Next.js, Astro and React with one define() call and zero dependencies. define() is under 1KB in React and under 1.5KB in Next.js, minified and gzipped in the browser, without the Next.js Link.
rules: Call define() once in a shared module, such as i18n.ts, and import the helpers it returns from that module.

In Next.js, use the server helpers (getMessages, getTranslations) in Server Components and the client hooks (useMessages, useTranslations) in Client Components. The client hooks throw in Server Components.
Interpolated values are not HTML-escaped. Sanitize user input before rendering a translation with dangerouslySetInnerHTML or set:html.
Import only the documented entry points. The internal subpaths of @i18n-tiny/core and @i18n-tiny/react are shared between the packages and are not part of the public API.
